title: Fixture record carrying the corrected replacements for the two guessed URLs
summary: Not a real record. The other half of the rule: url-check must not reject URLs that do serve their document, including one whose path states .pdf and serves application/pdf.
caseFor: An over-firing gate is the kind that gets loosened in a hurry by whoever is blocked by it.
caseAgainst: Proving a rule fires says nothing about whether it fires too much; both halves are needed.
